proposed_runner.label: ubuntu-24.04
proposed_runner.compute_price: Standard hosted runner compute is free for public repositories. No larger or paid runner selected.
proposed_runner.storage: Bound retained capture/results and use short artifact retention; no claim of unlimited free artifact storage.
proposed_runner.runtime_gate: Must actually verify /dev/net/tun, namespace creation, privilege, offload configuration, capture start and route isolation in the frozen-source job. Documentation is not execution evidence.

agreed_transport_scope.transport: QUIC UDP4433 with mutual rustls authentication and exact peer pins
agreed_transport_scope.warm_object_scope: Separate shared-core/MVM witness; not a claimed TUN packet-cache arm
agreed_transport_scope.underlay: One veth pair between two owned isolated namespaces; no host routing/NAT changes
agreed_transport_scope.capture: One underlay interface, both directions. Header-only classic PCAP, original link lengths and IP total lengths kept distinct; QUIC authentication, ACKs and retransmissions included.
agreed_transport_scope.existing_capture_limit: Existing spiralcore-capture hardcodes a TCP443/SYN-owned qualification path, so it must not be reused unchanged for UDP4433 QUIC. Root owns the small bounded UDP capture summary helper.

changes_performed: No VM creation, global installation, route change, provisioned host or Actions dispatch.
